## Description {#details}

<p>A recipe for handling first-order recurrence phis.</p>


<p>The start value is the first operand of the recipe and the incoming value from the backedge is the second operand.</p>


<p>Definition at line 2352 of file <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/files/lib/lib/transforms/lib/transforms/vectorize/vplan-h">VPlan.h</a>.</p>
